text: Monday. Plan was to finish the lab report before the gym. Instead I reorganised my spotify playlists, made a smoothie, replied to every group chat, and somehow it's 6pm. Report still at the intro. Gym didn't happen either.
the washing machine has been broken for two weeks and I still haven't rung the landlord. keep telling myself I'll do it after work
Had a whole free Saturday for the portfolio. Opened it once, closed it, and went down a youtube rabbit hole about bridges. Feel annoyed at myself.
Emails piling up. I read them, mark them unread, and tell myself I'll reply properly later. Later never comes.
Manager said my report was solid. I nodded but inside I was sure she hadn't read it properly. Everyone else on the team seems so much sharper than me.
Thinking about applying for the senior role but who am I kidding. They'd want someone who actually knows what they're doing.
Drafted my dating profile and deleted it. Nobody's going to be interested anyway.
Second-guessed every answer on the quiz and changed three right answers to wrong ones. Classic me.
Neighbour brought round soup when she heard I was ill. Didn't expect that at all. People can be so kind.
Good day. Coffee with Sam, sunshine on the walk back, cat asleep on my lap now. Feeling lucky honestly.
Looked through old photos tonight and felt so thankful for the friends I've had along the way.
Grandad turned 90 today. So glad we still have him and that I got to be there.
Day 21 of meal prepping on Sundays. Boring but it's working, haven't bought lunch out once.
Alarm at 5:45, didn't snooze, did the run in the rain. Not fun but it's done and I kept my promise to myself.
Put the phone in the drawer for my two study blocks again. Hard for the first ten minutes then fine.
I've practised guitar for 20 minutes every single day this month, even the days I really didn't want to.
Doctor wants to run more tests. Trying not to google symptoms but I've already convinced myself it's something serious. Chest tight all evening.
Party tonight and I've been dreading it all week. What if I've got nothing to say, what if people think I'm weird.
Woke at 4am with my heart pounding about the job interview. Couldn't get back to sleep.
Kept refreshing my bank app. Rent goes out Friday and I'm scared it won't cover it.
Third twelve hour shift in a row. Came home, sat in the dark, didn't eat. I can't keep doing this but I don't know how to stop.
Used to love teaching. Now I count down the minutes. Marking feels endless and I've got nothing left for the kids.
Holiday was meant to recharge me but I feel just as wiped out as before I left.
Everyone keeps asking for more and I keep saying yes. I'm running on fumes and I feel like a ghost at home.
Pitched my idea to the director and she loved it. Didn't hedge or apologise once. Proud of how I carried myself.
Went to the climbing wall alone for the first time. A few months ago I'd never have walked in by myself.
Told my friend no when she asked to borrow money again. Felt strong, not guilty.
Finished the interview feeling like I'd shown who I really am. Whatever happens I did myself justice.
Argument with dad about the car. Felt the heat coming up and I actually said I need five minutes and left the room. Came back and we sorted it.
Snapped at the cashier over nothing. Mortified. I need to notice the build up before it explodes.
Something small tipped me into tears at work. Went to the toilets, did box breathing, came back steady.
Journalling right after the fight helped me see I was more hurt than angry.
Handed in the dissertation draft two days late because chapter 2 just didn't feel right. Supervisor said it was fine weeks ago.
Redid my makeup three times before leaving and was late. Nobody would have noticed the first version.
Cleaned the kitchen until 1am because people are coming tomorrow and it has to be spotless.
Got positive feedback on my code review except one small comment and that comment is all I can think about.
Signed up for the course and I'm genuinely excited. First time in ages I've felt pulled towards something.
Can't find the energy to work on the business idea anymore. It felt so important in spring.
Saw a video of someone my age who started late and made it. Felt a spark, wrote out a plan straight away.
Running feels pointless at the moment. No goal, no race. Need something to aim for.
The visa form is due Friday and I'm too scared of getting it wrong to even open it. Every time I think about it my stomach drops so I do something else.
Rewrote my cover letter all evening because it never sounds good enough, and honestly I don't think I'm good enough for the job anyway.
Totally drained from work and I've lost any drive to do the side projects I used to love.
Six months of showing up at the gym every morning and today I lifted more than I ever thought I could. I'm starting to believe in myself.
Wanted to scream after the call but paused, breathed, and thought about everything that's going right. Felt thankful for my partner and calmed down.
Constant worry about the restructure on top of months of overtime. I'm exhausted and jumpy at the same time.
Went to Tesco, got pasta and some veg. Made spag bol. Watched the football.
Train was delayed twenty minutes. Read my book. Weather was grey.
Painted the spare room light blue. Took longer than expected but looks decent.
Booked flights for the wedding in June. Need to sort a hotel next week.
